name: Koukaku Idol Kirameku Stage de, Hirogaru Anal!
original_name: 肛拡アイドル　煌くステージで、拡がるアナル！
source:
"Ahh, did I get more readers today?"
I flipped down my official site hoping for new comments. My shoulders fell in disappointment.
It had been six months since my debut as an idol.
Since I was young, I've wanted to be an idol, and against my parents' wishes I auditioned at an agency.
It was like a dream, and I had no doubt at all that the future had great promise for me...

And I got my break as a gravure idol.
I was so happy!

.... But.

Photography: "... Hmmm... can you smile a little more naturally?"
My enthusiasm wasn't enough, and I got nervous. They had to reshoot.
I didn't get a second call.
At my wit's end, my eyes caught a report at the office. The No. 1 idol was an anal masturbating maniac.
Half jokingly, I thought about mimicking her style... all through the night.. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088241.html]DLsite English[/url]]
